contract: Velora Supercar Showroom Management — premium dark-mode dashboard for vehicle inventory, sales transactions, employees, and campaigns. Audience: showroom managers, sales associates, admins, finance. Tone: refined, technical, calm. Constraints: React 19 + TypeScript + Vite, Tailwind-ready design tokens, dark mode by default, lucide-react icons, recharts charts, WCAG 2.1 AA, responsive mobile (390x844) and desktop (1440x900).

accessibility.evidence: All interactive elements have visible focus-visible outlines (2px Sonata Gold). Buttons and icon-buttons are keyboard operable. Color contrast verified: text on charcoal surfaces exceeds WCAG AA (4.5:1). Touch targets >= 44px. ARIA labels on icon buttons and status badges. SR-only text for collapsed nav items.

responsive.evidence: Sidebar collapses on mobile with backdrop overlay. Metrics grid switches from 4-col desktop to 2-col tablet to 1-col mobile. Vehicle cards use auto-fill grid with minmax(280px, 1fr). Transaction table scrolls horizontally on narrow viewports. Page content padding adjusts for mobile.

loading.reason: Demo data is synchronous; no async loading states in current build. Will add skeletons when API is connected.

empty.evidence: Products page shows empty-state panel with CarFront icon and Clear filters action when no vehicles match filters.

error.reason: No error states triggered in demo build. Error toasts and banners ready for API integration.

partial.reason: No partial data scenarios in current build.

success.evidence: app-notice toast appears for successful actions (Add vehicle, New transaction, Edit). Dismissible with X button and aria-label.

permission.reason: Role-based UI gating (OWNER/ADMIN/HR/FINANCE/MARKETING/VIEWER) defined in Prisma but not yet enforced in client. Permission banner pattern documented.

renderedEvidence.observation: Mobile layout: sidebar collapses to overlay, metrics stack vertically, vehicle cards single column, transaction table scrolls horizontally.
Desktop layout: persistent sidebar, 4-col metrics grid, 2-col vehicle cards, full transaction table visible, showcase modal accessible.
